svg.title: T01 Pioneer motor-bicycle, c. 1894 to 1905, left side elevation
svg.desc: A bicycle-derived diamond frame with a small air-cooled single-cylinder engine mounted low in the frame, surface carburettor and fuel tank under the top tube, flat leather belt to a rim on the rear wheel, pedals, sprung saddle and spoon brake.

g.text: shoe rubs on the tyre tread
to start and to help on hills
